WWE SmackDown vs. Raw 2011 - PC Port
====================================

A native Windows build of the Xbox 360 game, statically recompiled with the
ReXGlue SDK. You need your own copy of the game (an Xbox 360 disc image).

INSTALL
  1. Run "SvR2011 Launcher.exe".
  2. Install tab: pick your disc image (.iso), pick a folder, press Install.
     Every file on the disc is copied out (about 5.3 GB) with a progress bar.
  3. Play tab: press Play.
  The game and the Mod Maker need Microsoft's Visual C++ runtime (x64,
  14.40 or newer) - most PCs have it. If yours hasn't, the launcher's
  Setup tab and Play say so and open Microsoft's download
  (https://aka.ms/vs/17/release/vc_redist.x64.exe).

SETTINGS (launcher, Settings tab - saved to svr2011.toml)
  Resolution   1280 x 720 is the game's native output and the default.
               Higher settings raise the window size and internal render
               scale; they are experimental for now.
  Display      Windowed or fullscreen.
  VSync        On by default.
  Controller   XInput (Xbox 360 / Xbox One / Series pads) is the default.
               SDL can be chosen for other gamepads.
  Audio        XAudio2 (default; 5.1 on surround setups, stereo otherwise).
               SDL is available as an alternative.

SAVES (the Saves folder; launcher, Saves tab)
  Every save is one file in Saves\ - you can copy, back up or share them
  like any file (close the game first):
    SaveData.dat           main save: settings, unlocks, progress (it ties
                           the others together - keep them with it)
    00CreateSuperStar.cas  created superstars      00PaintTool.pt  logos
    00RecordingDat.rec     replays                 00SceneDat.scn  highlight reels
  The launcher's Saves tab lists them: Back up all / Restore backup (backups
  go to SaveBackups\), export or import single saves, delete (to the Recycle
  Bin), open the folder. Restoring or importing backs up your saves first.
  Saves from earlier versions (UserData\...) are moved to Saves\ once.

PAINT TOOL (launcher, Paint Tool tab)
  Shows the Paint Tool's 20 logos. Export one (or all) as PNG, import any
  image into a logo (fitted into 256 x 256, transparency kept), or delete
  one. The game then shows and edits it like any logo. The Paint Tool save
  is made the first time you open CREATE A SUPERSTAR > PAINT TOOL in game.
  A created superstar can wear up to 10 different High Resolution (256 x
  256) logos here, not just 2. Logos 3 to 10 are kept in Saves\.logos (a
  hidden folder, backed up with the saves) - keep it with a superstar's
  save when you copy or share one. Low Resolution logos stay at 10, and the
  two sizes still can't be mixed on one superstar.

ENTRANCE MOVIES (launcher, Movies tab)
  Make an entrance movie from any video Windows can play (.mp4, .mov,
  .wmv, ...). The video goes on the arena's big screen; pick a picture or
  video for the strip below it (the stage and ramp screens), reuse a
  superstar's strip from the game's own movie (Superstar...), or leave it
  black. A movie made before (.bik) can be chosen as the video to make it
  again. "Fill the screen" (the default) makes the video cover the whole
  big screen; black bars already in the video are cut off. Movies are saved
  in the Custom Movies folder. In the game: CREATE AN ENTRANCE > FINALIZE >
  MOVIE > USER MOVIES lists them by name (X previews, A picks), like
  MUSIC > USER PLAYLIST; saved highlight reels are listed there too.
  Don't rename a movie an entrance uses (Custom Movies\ids.txt remembers
  which number each one has).

ENTRANCE MUSIC (your own songs)
  CREATE AN ENTRANCE > FINALIZE > MUSIC > USER PLAYLIST plays songs from the
  Music folder beside the game, as the Xbox 360 did from its hard drive.
  Give each song its own folder - the folder's name is what the game lists
  (Music\My Theme\song.mp3 shows as MY THEME). A song put straight in Music
  is listed under its file name. .mp3, .wma, .m4a, .aac, .wav and .flac all
  work. The game remembers the name, so don't rename a folder that an
  entrance uses. Launcher: Settings > Open Music folder.

UPDATES (launcher, Play tab)
  The launcher checks GitHub for a newer release when it starts (untick
  "Check when the launcher starts" to stop that) and asks before updating.
  An update replaces only the program files; saves, settings, music and
  movies are kept. "Check for updates" checks by hand.

STEAM DECK / LINUX (Proton; 55-60 fps on a Steam Deck)
  Runs through Proton. In Desktop Mode, add "SvR2011 Launcher.exe" to Steam
  (Add a Non-Steam Game), then Properties > Compatibility > force Proton
  Experimental, and install as on Windows (your Linux files are on drive Z:).
  For Game Mode, add the game folder's svr2011.exe the same way; it is
  fullscreen by default on a Deck. Steam + X opens the keyboard for names.
  Copy the whole Saves folder (with .info and .logos) to move your saves.
  Please report problems with the newest file from the logs folder.

CONTROLS
  Xbox controller - same layout as on the Xbox 360.
  Typing: while the game's on-screen keyboard is open (superstar names,
  Story Designer, ...) you can also type on the PC keyboard. Backspace
  deletes, Left/Right move the cursor, Enter confirms, Esc cancels.

IN-GAME OVERLAYS
  F2  FPS counter (on by default; top of the window)
  Graphics settings in game: MY WWE > OPTIONS > GRAPHICS
  F3  performance overlay     F4  settings     `  console / log

FILES
  svr2011.exe        the game
  *.dll              runtime (ReXGlue), GPU plugin (rexgpu-xenos.dll), FFmpeg
                     (rexffmpeg.dll) and LZX decoder (rexmspack.dll)
  native_shaders\    the native renderer's shaders (without them the game
                     uses the emulated renderer)
  svr2011.toml       settings
  Saves\             your saves (see SAVES)
  Music\             songs for entrances (see ENTRANCE MUSIC)
  Custom Movies\     entrance movies (see ENTRANCE MOVIES)
  SaveBackups\       save backups made by the launcher
  UserData\          shader cache, crash reports, installed DLC;
                     UtilityDrive\ is the game's scratch drive (about 400 MB)
  everything else    the disc files (pac\, sound\, movies\ ...); the game
                     updates two of them once for the PC: the menu text
                     (pac\string.pac) and the menus (pac\menu\menu.pac)

CREDITS
  The launcher's Setup tab can install tools for the Mod Maker into Tools\
  (Python, numpy, Pillow, ffmpeg): their licences are in Tools\LICENSES.
  Mod Maker Tools\vgmstream is vgmstream r2117 (https://github.com/vgmstream/vgmstream),
  which decodes the theme songs of WWE '12 and later for the superstar
  converter; its licence is Mod Maker Tools\vgmstream\COPYING, and its
  *-vgmstream-*.dll files are FFmpeg libraries under the LGPL.

STATUS
  Preview. Menus, exhibition matches with entrances, Create modes (superstar,
  entrance, Paint Tool), WWE Universe and saving all work, at 60 fps.
  Not every mode has been played through yet - please report problems
  (UserData\crashes\ holds crash reports).
